title: End To End Sustainability Tracking and Reporting for SMBs

chapters.title: Scorecards, goals, and chart of accounts
Recording emissions via journals and invoices

features.name: Sustainability Role Center
features.description: A dedicated role center designed for sustainability managers that brings together essential KPIs for ESG users, showing daily and monthly carbon footprint comparisons with previous periods and cumulative gas emissions.

features.name: Sustainability Chart of Accounts
features.description: A structured framework to catalog and log emissions data organized by scope or other groupings with unique identifiers, descriptions, and attributes that can track net changes and balances for different greenhouse gases.
caveats: Demo data shown; users can customize with their own data

features.name: Three Emission Scopes Coverage
features.description: The solution covers all three emission scopes with focus on reducing carbon footprint, tracks other greenhouse gases like methane and nitrous oxide, and includes carbon equivalent calculations.

features.name: Water and Waste Management Features
features.description: Future features to be introduced in next releases that will offer SMBs additional sustainability tools for tracking water and waste management alongside emissions.

features.name: Emissions Formulas
features.description: System allows automatic calculation of emissions through formulas based on inputs like fuel consumption, distance traveled, kilowatt hours, or other metrics with ability for partners to add specialized formulas.

features.name: Scorecards and Goal Tracking
features.description: Allows users to set and track sustainability goals with baseline periods, reporting periods, and target values to assess progress toward reducing environmental impact with multiple scorecards where one is set as main goal.

features.name: Sustainability Journal
features.description: A dedicated journal for recording gas emissions manually or via formulas with pre-populated sustainability accounts, descriptions, and validation to prevent incomplete entries.

features.name: Emissions Recording via Purchase Invoices
features.description: Allows recording emissions directly in purchase invoices by linking them to sustainability accounts, eliminating need to re-enter data into separate documents for financial and sustainability records.

features.name: Financial Reporting Tool for ESG
features.description: A no-code financial reporting tool built into Business Central that can combine sustainability data with financial and social data from different sources for custom ESG reporting, including metrics like emissions per dollar earned or carbon fees in profit calculations.

features.name: Built-in Emissions Reports
features.description: Standard reports including total emissions report with scope comparisons, emissions by category report with charts and tables, and category details showing average emissions per category.

features.name: ERP Integration for Sustainability
features.description: Sustainability entries are integrated with complete ERP system allowing users to view and manage general ledger entries, vendor entries, tax entries alongside sustainability entries in a single view during posting preview.

features.name: Emission Factor Configuration
features.description: Allows configuration of emission factors used in formulas based on category settings with ability to mark whether emissions are related to renewable energy.
